definition.en: Numbers that were counted or measured, such as how many pupils chose each fruit.
definition.zh: 数出来、量出来的一组数，比如选每种水果的有几人。

definition.en: A graph that shows numbers with pictures; its key says how many one picture stands for. (Mainland China textbooks: 象形统计图.)
definition.zh: 用图表示数的统计图；图例说一个图表示多少。（中国大陆课本叫“象形统计图”。）

definition.en: The small box on a picture graph that says how many one picture stands for.
definition.zh: 象形图上的小框，说明一个图表示多少。

definition.en: A graph that shows numbers by the length of bars, read against a scale. (Mainland China textbooks: 条形统计图.)
definition.zh: 用条的长短表示数的统计图，对着刻度读。（中国大陆课本叫“条形统计图”。）

definition.en: A straight line along the side or bottom of a bar graph or line graph, with a scale on it.
definition.zh: 条形图、折线图边上或底下的直线，上面有刻度。

definition.en: The numbers along an axis; how much one gridline stands for.
definition.zh: 轴上的数；每一格表示多少。

definition.en: A thin line across a graph from a mark on the scale; it helps you read where a bar ends.
definition.zh: 从刻度上的一点横过整张图的细线，帮你读出条顶在哪里。

definition.en: Numbers set out in rows and columns, each with a name.
definition.zh: 把数排成行和列，每一行、每一列都有名字。

definition.en: Short strokes made while counting; four strokes and one across make a bundle of 5.
definition.zh: 边数边画的短线；四竖加一斜是一捆，表示 5。

definition.en: A graph of readings taken one after another, joined in order by straight lines to show how something changes. (Mainland China textbooks: 折线统计图.)
definition.zh: 把先后测得的读数按顺序用直线连起来，表示一样东西怎么变化。（中国大陆课本叫“折线统计图”。）

definition.en: A circle cut into parts to show how a whole is shared; the whole circle is everything. (Mainland China textbooks: 扇形统计图.)
definition.zh: 把圆分成几份，表示一个整体怎么分；整个圆是全部。（中国大陆课本叫“扇形统计图”。）

definition.en: How much a reading went up or down: the difference between two readings.
definition.zh: 读数升了多少或降了多少：两个读数的差。
